questions.question: Rise in sugar levels in blood is detected by the
questions.solution:
__
 
• Rise in sugar levels in the blood is detected by the **Pancreas.**__
 
• The pancreas detects the rise in blood glucose and starts to secrete insulin.
 
• The pancreas is a gland that is located in the abdomen of the body. It is part of the digestive system which produces insulin and other important enzymes and hormones that help in breaking down the foods.
 
• After eating something, the carbohydrates in food are broken down into glucose and passed into the bloodstream.
 
• In response to rising glucose in the bloodstream, insulin is released from the beta cells of the pancreas which regulate the body’s glucose or sugar level.
 
• Any disorder in the pancreas leads to diabetes.

questions.question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the following assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

The headmistress called for an urgent meeting for all staff members to discuss on discipline issues.

**Assumption:**

I. There were some discipline issues that were raised earlier.

II. The headmistress likes to address all of them together

options.text: Both I and II are implicit
Neither I nor II is implicit

questions.solution:
• The given statement says that the headmistress wants to discuss "discipline issues" in the "urgent" meeting.
 
• Therefore, we can safely assume that there were some discipline issues raised earlier which caused the holding of an "urgent" meeting.
 
• However, the statement does not suggest that the headmistress’ reason for convening a meeting is her desire to address the staff members ‘together’.
 
• Hence, only assumption I is implicit.

questions.question: A person lifts luggage of 20 kg from the ground and puts it on his head 2 m above the ground. Calculate the work done by him. (g = 10 ms⁻²)
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Work is said to be done by a force when the body is displaced actually through some distance in the direction of the applied force.
 
• Since the body is being displaced in the direction of Force (F), therefore work done by the force in displacing the body through a distance (s) is given by:

W = vec F · vec s

Or, W = Fs cos θ

CALCULATION__:

Given that:

Mass (m) = 20 kg

Distance (h) = 2 m

Acceleration due to gravity (g) = 10 ms⁻²

Work done (W) = Fs

**W = m g h** (F = mass x acceleration due to gravity)

W = 20 x 2 x 10 J

**W = 400 J**

questions.question: A natural number, when divided by 9, 10, 12 or 15, leaves a remainder of 3 in each case. What is the smallest of all such numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number on being divided by 9, 10, 12, and 15 gives a remainder of 3 in each case.

**Concept:**

Take LCM of all the divisions and add the remainder so obtained (same in each case) to it.

LCM = Least Common Multiple (Least value which is exactly divisible by all the given numbers)

**Calculation: **

⇒ 9 = 3 × 3

⇒ 10 = 2 × 5

⇒ 12 = 2 × 2 × 3

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

LCM of (9, 10, 12 and 15) = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 = 180

**∴ Required number = 180 + 3 = 183.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Required number = LCM of (9, 10, 12 and 15) + 3 = 180 + 3 = 183

5 – Jan – 96 to 27 – Jan – 96 → 23 days

27 – Jan – 96 to 18 – Feb – 96 → 23 days

18 – Feb – 96 to 11 – Mar – 96 (not 12 – Mar – 96) → 23 days

11 – Mar – 96 (not 12 – Mar – 96) to 2 – April – 96 → 23 days

Hence, ’12 – 03 – 96’ does not fit the series.

questions.question: The mean of 21 observation (all different) is 40. If each observation greater than the median is increased by 21 then the mean of observation will become:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mean of 21 observations is 40.

Total observ
ations = 21

each observation greater than the median is increased by 21

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of observations

**Calculation:**

Mean of 21 observations is 40.

Sum of the observation = 21 × 40 = 840

As all numbers are different so we can arrange the numbers in ascending/descending order.

Median of 21 observation = (21 + 1)/2 = 11th observation

Observations greater than median = (21 – 11) = 10

According to the question,

Last 10 numbers will be increased by 21 

Increase in sum = 10 × 21 = 210

New sum of the observations = 840 + 210 = 1050

New mean of observations = 1050/21 = 50

**∴ New mean will be 50.**

questions.question: Let A(0, -1), B(0, 3) and C(2, 1) be three points. Let Δ₁ be the area of the triangle ABC and Δ₂ be the area of the triangle formed by the mid points of the sides of the triangle whose vertices are A, B and C such that (Delta₂ )/(Delta₁)=(1)/(x) Find the value of x.
questions.solution:
**Concept: **

When the midpoints of the two sides are joined by a line then that line is parallel to the third side of the triangle.

The ratio of the area of the triangle formed by the line joining the midpoints to the area of the original triangle is equal to the ratio of the square of the corresponding sides of the triangles. 

**Calculation:**

Here, we need not to solve whole question.

By, properties of triangle

If a new triangle is formed by joining mid points of sides of a given triangle, then ratio of area of new triangle to area of given triangle is equal to 1 : 4.

Area of given triangle = Δ1

Area of new triangle formed by midpoints = Δ2

(Δ₂ )/(Δ₁)= (1)/(4)

Hence, (Delta₂ )/(Delta₁)=(1)/(x) = (1)/(4)

∴ x = 4.

questions.question: The mass number of an isotope of an element is 298. If its nucleus has 189 neutrons, what is its atomic number?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The** Mass number** is always equal to the sum of the number of protons and the number of neutrons. The mass number determines the Atomic mass of an atom, Mass Number is denoted by A
 
• The **Atomic number** of an element is the number of protons present in the nucleus of an atom, Atomic Number is denoted by Z.

Atomic Number = Number of Protons

Mass Number = Number of Protons + Number of Neutrons

 
• Here, Mass Number = 298

Number of Protons + Number of Neutrons = 298

Number of Protons = 298 - 189 = 109

Hence, Atomic Number = **109 __**[As, Atomic Number = Number of Protons]

 
• **Isotopes **are defined as elements with the same number of protons but a different number of neutrons present in their nucleus. As the electrons remain the same, so their chemical properties don’t change however due to change in neutron number their atomic mass is changed which results in different physical properties like melting, colour, etc.

questions.question: “When a card placed over a tumbler is flicked with the finger, the coin placed over it falls in the tumbler”.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 3**__ i.e__** Law of Inertia.**__

__**Concept:-**__

__
 
• Friction: Friction is a force that opposes the motion of two surfaces that are in contact. In this scenario, friction plays a minor role as it is not sufficient to overcome the inertia of the coin to carry it along with the card.
 
• Gravity: Gravity is the force that attracts two bodies toward each other. Once the card is flicked away and the coin starts to fall, gravity is the force that accelerates it downward into the tumbler.
 
• Newton's Second Law of Motion: This law states that the acceleration of an object is dependent upon two variables - the net force acting upon the object and the mass of the object. In the context of the coin, once it starts to fall, its acceleration due to gravity is explained by this law.
 
• Newton's Third Law of Motion: This law states that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. While it does not directly explain the coin's drop, it's exemplified in the interaction between the finger and the card when flicked.

**Explanation:-__**

The Law of Inertia, also known as Newton's First Law of Motion, states that an object at rest stays at rest, and an object in motion continues in motion with the same speed and in the same direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force. Essentially, this law describes the resistance of any physical object to any change in its state of motion, including changes to its speed and direction.

In the scenario with the card and the coin, initially, both the card and the coin are at rest. When the card is flicked, an external force is applied to it, causing it to move. However, no significant external force is applied to the coin at the moment the card is flicked. The coin's inertia causes it to resist any change in its state of motion. Thus, as the card is rapidly moved out from under it, the coin doesn't move with the card but instead falls vertically due to gravity into the tumbler below.

So, The Correct Answer is __Option 3__ i.e__ Law of Inertia.__

questions.question: The force that a neutron exerts on a proton inside an atom is:
questions.solution:
**Nuclear force**:

● **Hideki Hukawa** discovered the **theory of nuclear forces**.

● The forces acting between **2 or more nucleons** are known as nuclear forces.

● A Nuclear force is a force that exists between nucleons (protons and neutrons)** inside a nucleus**.

● Since it exists inside the nucleus, it is a **short-range force**.

● With a force about times stronger than the gravitational force, nuclear force is the strongest force in nature.

questions.question: A water tank is filled in 5 hours by three pipes X, Y and Z. The pipe Z is thrice as fast as Y and Y is twice as fast as X. How much time will pipe X alone take to fill the water tank?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

Time taken by X alone = 5 × (1 + 2 + 6)/1 = 45 hours

**Detailed Solution: **

Let, in 1 hour X can fill = a lit

∴ In 1 hour Y can fill = 2a lit

∴ In 1 hour Z can fill = 6a lit

∴ Capacity of the tank = 5(a + 2a + 6a) = 45a lit

Let, X alone can fill the tank in t hours

According to the question,

⇒ t × a = 45a

⇒ t = 45

∴ X alone can fill the tank in = 45 hours

• 
 It is located in the Shillong Plateau in the Meghalaya State of India.

•

questions.solution:
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Cost price of the article = Rs 595 × 100/119 = Rs 500

∴ Loss percentage = (500 – 475)/500 × 100% = 5%

**Detailed Solution: **

Let the cost price of the article = Rs 100x

According to the question,

⇒ 100x + 100x × 19/100 = 595

⇒ 119x = 595

⇒ x = 5

∴ Cost Price of the article = Rs (100 × 5) = Rs 500

New selling price = Rs 475

∴ Loss = Rs (500 – 475) = Rs 25

∴ Loss percentage = 25/500 × 100% = 5%

questions.question:
Given is a statement followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. Consider the statement and the following assumptions and decide which of the assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

All the species of plants and animals are part of biodiversity and ecosystems and play major role in the overall health of the environment.

**Assumptions:**

I. Preserve or create a backyard habitat. Save as many native plants as you can when building or landscaping.

II. One of the major goals of sustainability is to preserve biodiversity. All life on Earth is connected through the flow of energy (planetary food web), and each time a species becomes endangered or lost to extinction, one more part of that energy flow is lost.

options.text: Neither assumption I nor II is implicit
Both assumptions I and Ii are implicit

questions.solution:
The statement says that plants and animals are a part of biodiversity and the ecosytem, and that their existence is important for a healthy environment.

Thus, it indirectly suggests that there is a need to protect these species.

Assumption II emphasizes that these species must be protected to preserve biodiversity and explains their role in the ecosystem.

Also, the phrase ‘part of ecosystems’ means that we can assume we know the meaning of an ecosystem.

Therefore, assumption II is implicit.

However, the statement does not suggest any measure to ensure the protection of the species of plants and animals.

Therefore, assumption I is not implicit.

Hence, only assumption II is implicit.
